summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments on PR #296 (cipher-box SDK extraction), fix a CI E2E test build failure, and improve the E2E test infrastructure to avoid exposing Zustand stores in production builds.
summary.outcome: All PR review threads resolved across multiple review passes; CI workflow fixed to build new packages before web; E2E infrastructure refactored to use VITE_E2E flag for minimal store exposure, UI-based vault readiness checks, and Settings page for public key extraction.

repo: The cipher-box monorepo has 5 independently versioned packages (crypto, core, api-client, sdk-core, sdk) — when all touched in one PR, Release Please bumps them all simultaneously on first release, then they diverge naturally
release-please multi-component PRs use the target branch name instead of ${version} in the title — root-level pull-request-title-pattern should omit ${version}
__ZUSTAND_STORES is only exposed when import.meta.env.DEV — production E2E CI builds never set this, causing silent test failures for any test relying on Zustand store access
The FolderTree.clear() method zeroes all stored key buffers, meaning registerFolder must make defensive copies or callers' buffers get zeroed on destroy()

The isLoaded flag on FolderNode is not set in all code paths — SDK-created folders and root folder after vault init have valid keys but isLoaded may be false, causing the ensureFolderRegistered guard to silently skip registration

E2E workflows (e2e.yml, deploy-staging.yml, e2e-desktop.yml) only built @cipherbox/crypto before web — the 4 new packages (core, api-client, sdk-core, sdk) were never being built, breaking all CI builds after PR #296 merged
Public key for sharing is displayed on the Settings page at .settings-pubkey-value — no need to extract from Zustand for sharing tests
conflict-detection tests are the only active tests that genuinely need store internals (accessToken and rootIpnsName) — sharing/invite tests only need publicKey which is in the UI

code.finding: Zustand store exposure gated on import.meta.env.DEV — must also check import.meta.env.VITE_E2E for CI E2E builds
ensureFolderRegistered guard on isLoaded was too strict — isLoaded not set in all code paths, causing silent registration skips and 'Folder not loaded' errors at upload time
fileKey not cleared if exception occurs before the re-wrap try/catch — needs try/finally wrapping entire post-upload section
Background re-wrap shares folderKey buffer with caller — needs defensive copy before spawning background operation
createFolder leaks plaintext folderKey/ipnsPrivateKey on exception — duplicate-name check should happen before key generation, keys need clearBytes in catch
Throwing lifecycle hooks can break operations — needs notifySafely() wrapper for all config callbacks
Test 3.7 timeout 240s was insufficient for cumulative waits (~330s worst case); increased to 360s
waitForFunction polling __ZUSTAND_STORES for vault readiness never resolves in production builds — replaced with UI wait for file list empty state
Context leak on failure during account creation — cleanup calls need .catch(() => undefined) to avoid masking original error
Passing Uint8Array directly to Blob needs 'as BlobPart' type assertion for TypeScript strict mode compatibility
requestAnimationFrame handle not cancelled in effect cleanup — focusRaf must be hoisted to effect scope

workflow: When fixing stale CI branches after a PR merges, always check whether the fix commit landed on main before creating a new branch — it may not have if the merge happened before the push
Vite VITE_* env vars are baked in at compile time and tree-shaken in production builds where they're not set — safe pattern for E2E-only instrumentation
Release Please independent versioning works correctly; apparent simultaneous bumps on first release are expected because the initial PR touched all packages
pnpm --filter builds are parallel — packages with dependency ordering need sequential build steps or topological awareness in CI

E2E test infrastructure should prefer UI selectors over internal state access; when internal state is genuinely needed (e.g. tokens for direct API calls), expose minimal window.__E2E helpers rather than full store objects

friction: isLoaded guard added based on reviewer suggestion caused a regression (upload failures) that required a follow-up PR #301 — reviewer suggestion was architecturally unsound given the actual code paths
CI E2E build failure was caused by missing package builds in workflow — not caught until after PR #296 merged because the workflow was never updated for the new packages
Tests were passing locally but failing in CI due to __ZUSTAND_STORES only being exposed in DEV builds — production CI builds silently had no store access for months without being caught
The fix for CI builds was committed to an already-merged branch, requiring a second new branch and PR
Background task output files had to be checked for test results due to async test runner; some runs completed before results were inspected
orval codegen produces incorrect type for nullable Date fields (VaultResponseDtoInitializedAt) — regenerating produces the same wrong output, upstream codegen bug
Stale lock file caused initial commit to fail, requiring manual removal
open_items: Concurrent mutations to the same folder can lose updates (Thread 2 from first review pass) — marked not applicable for this PR but flagged as architectural concern for follow-up
web3auth-helpers.ts (email-based login flow) still references __ZUSTAND_STORES but is legacy code — should be cleaned up or removed once wallet-based flow is fully validated
recycle-bin.spec.ts uses __ZUSTAND_STORES__ (double underscore suffix, different variable) with a fallback — should be audited for the same production build issue
VaultResponseDtoInitializedAt generated type is wrong (orval bug with nullable Date) — needs upstream fix or manual override in orval config
E2E test 3.7 (session restore after reload) has remaining flakiness on Sapphire Devnet in CI — root cause is slow/failed Core Kit session restore, not yet fully addressed
PR #298 (Release Please) titled 'chore: release main' — fix merged via PR #300 but next release PR will be the first to validate the new title format
